question: To what kind of person who has been tested for one year must a certain thing be given?
premises: A certain thing is to be given.
The recipient is one previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one year.
inference: Transmission is restricted to a previously accomplished person tested over the course of one year.
uncertainties: The object to be given is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: That which is to be given must go to one who was previously accomplished and tested for one year.
